text:
sam: heads-up: saw a tenant hammer embeddings with mixed dims but most items tiny; it filled fastpath slots and bumped latency for high-dim requests.
ira: interesting. so small items stole the fast gpu slots?
sam: yes. continuous-batching coalesced by arrival, not by dim. result: 512-dim quick requests queued behind 1024-dim long-running batches.
marta: we talked about routing by dim buckets before but never wired tenant credit signals into it. proposal: dim-priority routing + credit estimate header so console can show "will this request use credits/fastpath".
ira: sketch: ingress calculates an "embed_credit_estimate" using dims + items -> returns header `X-Embed-Credit-Estimate: 42` and `X-Embed-Route-Suggestion: fastpath|slowpath`. SDK/console can display before send. If tenant has credits < estimate, route to slowpath automatically or ask for confirm.
console-pm: UX idea: on the Embeddings page show a small gauge: "Fastpath credits: 1200" and when user pastes items show estimated cost and an action button: "Use fastpath (cost: 42 credits)" or "Send slowpath (free)". Also a tooltip explaining difference (latency vs cost).
sdk-team: SDK can read `X-Embed-Route-Suggestion` and offer `client.route='slow'|'fast'`. Also can opt-in to auto-defer to slowpath when credits insufficient. We'll add header `X-Embed-Client-Used-Route: fast|slow` on submit.
telemetry-bot: telemetry fields requested: `embeds.credit_estimate`, `embeds.route_chosen`, `embeds.fastpath_queue_time_ms`, `tenant.fastpath_credits_remaining_bucket`. Keep cardinality low by bucketing credits.
ira: runtime changes: maintain fastpath slot accounting per-tenant; pre-debit credits on accept or on route decision? We should pre-debit to avoid overcommit, but that requires atomic update. Maybe best-effort: optimistic decrement + reconcile via telemetry.
marta: console needs an override toggle "Always prefer fastpath" and an admin panel to top-up credits per API key. Also a banner when credits are low with link to billing.
sdk-team: implementation: ingress quick-calc uses dims weighting (e.g., 512->1 unit, 768->1.5, 1024->2) * items -> credit_estimate. Then if tenant_credits >= estimate and fastpath capacity exists -> route fast. Else route slow and return header suggestion.
sam: how about mixed-dims within one request? Return `X-Embed-PerItem-Estimate: 1,1.5,2,1`? That might be too high-cardinality. Keep it as total estimate.
telemetry-bot: add event `embeds.route_funnel` with labels: estimated_units_bucket, route_chosen, outcome(success|retry), client_chunked(true|false).
sdk-team: for rollout: metrics-only for 2 weeks (emit headers but don't change routing), then opt-in flag per-tenant to enable credit-aware routing, then 10% global canary.
marta: console rollout: show gauge in beta for tenants flagged for opt-in, and add small "simulate cost" feature so users can paste and see estimates without sending.
ira: SLO note: fastpath queueing times will change, tag @eng-oncall for canary window. Also add dashboards comparing p99 for fastpath vs slowpath by tenant.
sam: I'll open runtime PR and small benchmark that simulates mixed small+large item patterns.
telemetry-bot: schema updated: embeds.credit.v1 (fields: credit_estimate, route_suggestion, tenant_credit_bucket).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: embeds-dim-routing v0.1 -> staging (sha: baddcafe).
sdk-team: we'll add `auto_slow_when_low_credits` flag in SDK and track adoption via `X-Embed-Client-Used-Route`.
marta: I'll draft product copy: "Fastpath uses reserved GPU slots for lower latency and consumes credits. Slowpath is queue-based and has higher P99 but no credits consumed."
sam: ok moving forward. tickets: ING-3100 (dim-priority routing), SDK-720 (route-aware client), DOC-412 (credits UX).
